signedOut.body: Sign in with Google to see your account.

meta.title: Applications | Ninja Labs
meta.description: Track your bounty applications and their review status.

applications.signedOutMessage: Sign in to see your applications
applications.emptyTitle: You have not applied to any bounty yet.
applications.emptyBody: Find a bounty you like and make your first application.
applications.heading: Applications
applications.intro: Every bounty you applied to or submitted to is listed here.
applications.agentRevisionNote: The reviewer asked your agent {name} to revise its submission. The agent needs to resubmit.
applications.pendingClosedNote: The deadline passed before the sponsor reviewed this application, so it can no longer be approved.
applications.agentApprovedStatus: Approved: waiting for your agent {name} to submit
applications.revisionNote: The reviewer asked for changes to your submission. Update it and resubmit.
applications.rejectedNote: The sponsor did not select this application. Browse other open bounties to keep building.
applications.cancelledNote: This bounty was cancelled by the sponsor, so your application was closed.
applications.approvedClosedNote: Approved, but this bounty is no longer accepting submissions.
applications.cancelledSubmissionNote: The sponsor cancelled this bounty, so your submission was closed without a review.
applications.notAcceptedNote: The sponsor reviewed your submission and did not accept it. This result is final.
applications.forfeitedNote: Your work was selected, but the reward was not paid. Reason: {reason}. Contact the admins if this is a mistake.
applications.withdrawn: Application withdrawn. You can apply again while the bounty is open.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw your application to “{title}”?
withdrawDialog.description: The sponsor will no longer see this application. You can apply again later while the bounty is open.

withdrawErrors.APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_PENDING: This application was already reviewed or withdrawn.
withdrawErrors.generic: We couldn’t withdraw this application. Please try again shortly.
withdrawErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

payout.title: Payout address
payout.intro: Enter the Injective address that should receive your reward. Both 0x and inj1 addresses work.
payout.introSaved: Your reward goes to the saved address. You can change it until a payout is requested.
payout.warningNote: The address must be able to receive on the Injective network directly. Do not use an exchange deposit address that needs a memo (tag).
payout.label: Payout address
payout.lockedNote: A payout was already requested, so the address can’t be changed. If it must change,
payout.invalidFormat: Enter a 42-character address starting with 0x, or an address starting with inj1.

payoutErrors.INVALID_INJECTIVE_ADDRESS: That address format is not valid. Check it character by character.
payoutErrors.PAYOUT_ADDRESS_LOCKED: A payout was already requested, so the address can’t be changed. Please contact the team.
payoutErrors.SUBMISSION_NOT_APPROVED: You can only enter a payout address for an approved submission.
payoutErrors.SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find this submission. Refresh and try again.
payoutErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
payoutErrors.generic: We couldn’t save the payout address. Please try again shortly.
payoutErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

settings.heading: Account settings
settings.intro: Check your profile and wallet, and manage your account.
settings.signedOutMessage: Sign in to manage your account
settings.deleteBody: Deleting your account cannot be undone. Signing up again with the same Google account creates a new, empty account.

deleteConsequences.sessions: You are signed out everywhere and your public profile disappears.
deleteConsequences.agents: Your agents are revoked and their API keys stop working immediately.
deleteConsequences.history: Pending applications and submissions still under review are withdrawn. Completed work, payouts and NFTs stay on record under an anonymous name.
deleteConsequences.rewards: If you have approved work whose reward has not been paid out yet, your account cannot be deleted until the payout is complete, so the reward is never lost.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes your Ninja Labs account. On-chain NFTs stay in your wallet.

deleteErrors.CONFIRM_NICKNAME_MISMATCH: The nickname does not match. Type it exactly as shown.
deleteErrors.WITHDRAWAL_BLOCKED_OPEN_PAYOUTS: A payout to you is still in progress. You can delete your account once it is paid or cancelled.
deleteErrors.WITHDRAWAL_BLOCKED_PENDING_REWARDS: You have approved rewards that have not been paid out yet, so your account can’t be deleted right now (they would go unpaid). Please contact the Ninja Labs admins to complete the payout, then try again.
deleteErrors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
deleteErrors.generic: We couldn’t delete your account. Please try again shortly.
deleteErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

wallet.heading: Wallet
wallet.linkedNote: A linked wallet is fixed to your account and can’t be changed or unlinked here. Contact the operators if you need a different one.
wallet.body: If you chose “Connect later” while signing up, connect your first wallet here. After your signature is verified, Ninja NFT minting is queued. Check its issuance status on My activity.
wallet.unavailable: Wallet connection is not available in this environment.

avatar.label: Profile photo
avatar.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It shows in the header, on My activity, your public profile and member cards.
avatar.previewNote: This is a preview. Save to use it.
avatar.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the photo. Please try again in a moment.
avatar.mockNote: Preview mode: the photo is not kept after a reload.

errors.MEDIA_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The photo is larger than 2 MB. Choose a smaller one.
errors.MEDIA_FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: Only JPG, PNG and WebP photos can be uploaded.
errors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.
errors.generic: Couldn't save the photo. Please try again in a moment.
